Intro

This dashboard contains five visualizations using datasets related to arrests, COVID-19 statistics, and city safety indicators. The first graph is a bar chart displaying the Arrests by Sex and Race. The second graph is a histogram displaying the distribution of student enrollment across Massachusetts schools. The data is from the NCES Massachusetts school excel datasheet.
